title: A White Heron
author: Sarah Orne Jewett
short_description: A girl who knows where a rare white heron nests must choose between telling a hunter she admires and protecting the bird.
description: Sylvia climbs a great pine tree at dawn and sees the whole world — including the white heron's nest. When she returns to the hunter who wants the bird for his collection, she finds she cannot speak. A perfect story about loyalty to the natural world over human desire.
